# Ooh La La Brasserie

> Ooh La La Brasserie is a Parisian-inspired café and brasserie in Enfield, North London (238 Hertford Road, EN3 5BL). It serves speciality coffee and breakfast, brunch and lunch with Mediterranean flavours, plus afternoon cocktails. Open every day, 8am to 5pm. Walk-ins welcome; tables can be booked online.

## Key facts

- Address: 238 Hertford Road, Enfield, London EN3 5BL, United Kingdom (on the A1010 Hertford Road, near Enfield Lock and Enfield Highway, a few minutes from M25 junction 25)
- Opening hours: Monday to Sunday, 8am to 5pm. Last food orders 4:30pm.
- Phone: +44 20 8374 5097
- Email: info@oohlalabrasserie.com
- Price range: about £10 to £20 per main dish
- Bookings: walk-ins welcome every day; book a table online at https://www.oohlalabrasserie.com/book
- Dietary: Halal options, vegetarian, vegan and gluten-aware dishes
- Drinks: speciality coffee (espresso, flat white, latte, cortado, Spanish latte and more), teas, smoothies, milkshakes, and a cocktail and mocktail menu from midday, with wine and beer
- Private hire: birthdays, group brunches, baby showers and corporate events, for up to 60 guests
- Parking: on-street parking on Hertford Road; free car park at nearby Enfield Retail Park
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/oohlalabrasserie
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/oohlalabrasserie

## What it is known for

- Full English and Mediterranean breakfasts, including a sharing Mediterranean breakfast for two with sujuk, kaymak, cheeses, honey and Turkish tea
- Brunch classics: eggs Benedict, eggs Royale, smashed avocado on sourdough
- Pancakes, French toast and sweet brunch dishes
- A relaxed, stylish space suited to coffee, catch-ups, working and celebrations
